$comment: The teaching plan (#2868, ADR-W-208), moved here from the roadmap page's database (plan/current, version 31, 2026-11-13). The management page reads it from GitHub; a pull from the page is a commit to this file. name/goal are the page's Hebrew; nameEn, why, done and schedule are the plan's original English record.
title: תוכנית ההוראה

groups.label: עכשיו · אנליטית: מקום גיאומטרי, אחר כך אליפסה, אחר כך פרבולה

workstreams.done: A point with one degree of freedom offers its locus on screen; the equation is complete (with the parameter where there is one); the stated figure stays in view.
workstreams.goal: תלמיד מגלה מקום גיאומטרי ומשתמש בו בלי משפט קסם.
workstreams.name: למצוא מקום גיאומטרי ולהשתמש בו בלי לדעת את המשפט המדויק
workstreams.schedule: W1–W2, done before ellipse starts on 14 Nov. #1182 after #1687 (same solver code). The chip (#1177) and the equation with its letter (#1186) are features, each its own PR. Ruled 26 Oct: the chip and guide row are the only way in; the path shows only on request; the freedom line only reports.
workstreams.why: Locus is next in class, and it is the most-asked construct in the analytic corpus (13 of 20 first questions). The engine already computes loci, but the commands guide has no locus row and nothing on screen says a locus exists.
workstreams.nameEn: Find and use a locus without knowing the exact sentence

workstreams.done: «D על BC» after «משולש ABC» leaves the triangle in place; a new length resizes rather than redraws.
workstreams.goal: הוספת נתון לא מזיזה נקודות שכבר מסורטטות.
workstreams.name: נתון חדש משאיר את הנקודות במקומן
workstreams.schedule: W1–W2, pulled forward 30 Oct: a figure that jumps breaks locus. #1687 first (option A, line provenance, ruled 30 Oct), then #2039.
workstreams.why: It is the core promise of the tool and the heart of its positioning against AI pictures.
workstreams.nameEn: Adding a given keeps existing points in place

workstreams.done: The locus bagrut questions and the book examples you pick build step by step, easily and correctly. You play the sheet.
workstreams.goal: האנליטית מוכנה להמשך שיעורי המקום הגיאומטרי.
workstreams.name: אתה בודק: שיעורי המקום הגיאומטרי מוכנים
workstreams.schedule: Play the locus sheet by 12 Nov.
workstreams.why: The exit of the current phase.
workstreams.nameEn: You check: locus lessons are ready

workstreams.done: Every ellipse exercise in the sweep builds or has an issue; the foci are marked on the canvas (ruled 7 Oct).
workstreams.goal: תרגילי האליפסה שאתה מלמד, כולל המקום הגיאומטרי של נקודה על אליפסה, נבנים צעד אחר צעד.
workstreams.name: תרגילי האליפסה נבנים, מוכנים ל-14 בנוב׳
workstreams.schedule: Sweep done 30 Oct (about 40 book exercises): no figure that builds is wrong except two printing/locus bugs; the book’s phrasing mostly does not parse. W2: the two wrong answers (#2613, #2614), the foci and vertices (#2616) and the sizes (#2617), which block about 20 exercises. W2–W3: the circle’s relations for the ellipse (#2618), the book’s clauses (#2619), the foci marks (#1218, #1863). W3: the locus wordings (#2620). Later: #2615, #2621.
workstreams.why: You start ellipses on 14 Nov, for about two weeks, and teach their loci as part of the shape.
workstreams.nameEn: Ellipse exercises build, ready for 14 Nov

workstreams.done: You play the ellipse sheet before 14 Nov.
workstreams.name: אתה בודק: שיעורי האליפסה מוכנים
workstreams.why: The exit of the ellipse preparation.
workstreams.nameEn: You check: ellipse lessons are ready

workstreams.done: Every parabola exercise in the sweep builds or has an issue; the focus and directrix are marked (ruled 7 Oct).
workstreams.goal: תרגילי הפרבולה שאתה מלמד, כולל המקום הגיאומטרי שלה, נבנים צעד אחר צעד.
workstreams.name: תרגילי הפרבולה נבנים, מוכנים לכ-28 בנוב׳
workstreams.schedule: W4: the sweep. W4–W5: the focus and directrix marks (#1752) and the sweep’s findings.
workstreams.why: Parabola follows ellipse, from about 28 Nov.
workstreams.nameEn: Parabola exercises build, ready for ~28 Nov

workstreams.done: You play the parabola sheet before about 28 Nov.
workstreams.name: אתה בודק: שיעורי הפרבולה מוכנים
workstreams.why: The exit of the parabola preparation.
workstreams.nameEn: You check: parabola lessons are ready

workstreams.done: Every issue here is closed or ruled.
workstreams.goal: שום דבר שגוי לא מוצג כנכון באנליטית, ומה שנתקלת בו בכיתה עובד.
workstreams.name: האנליטית לא מראה דבר שגוי, ומה שנתקלת בו בכיתה עובד
workstreams.schedule: W3–W6, alongside the conic work, wrong answers first, as room allows.
workstreams.why: Placed 30 Oct from outside the plan: wrong answers and issues a person hit, in the tool you teach with.
workstreams.nameEn: Analytic shows nothing false, and what you hit in class works

workstreams.done: Two circles with «המעגל הראשון», the common external tangent and clickable centres all build in analytic.
workstreams.goal: מה שנתקלת בו בכיתה השבוע עובד.
workstreams.name: מה שנתקלת בו בכיתה ב-25 באוק׳ עובד
workstreams.schedule: W1. Ruled 26 Oct: only the exam’s two «המעגל הראשון» sentences (D8); «P מרכז מעגל» creates a new circle (D9); analytic refuses a chord through the centre like 2-D for now (D10).
workstreams.why: Real class inputs: what a person actually hit comes first.
workstreams.nameEn: What you hit in class on 25 Oct works

workstreams.done: Every issue here is closed or ruled.
workstreams.goal: אפשר לכתוב ישרים ונקודות כמו שספר הלימוד כותב אותם.
workstreams.name: לכתוב ישרים ונקודות כמו בספר הלימוד
workstreams.why: Placed 30 Oct from outside the plan. Moved after the conic lessons: they are capabilities, not things anyone hit.
workstreams.nameEn: Write lines and points the way the textbook does

workstreams.done: Several free vectors, sums drawn head to tail, a vector from a known point creates its end point, and «AB = k» / «AB = AC» read sensibly.
workstreams.goal: בדף ריק: «וקטור u», «וקטור v», «w = u + v»: וקטורים צפים ותמונת ראש לזנב.
workstreams.name: וקטורים חופשיים בדף ריק, בחיבור ראש לזנב
workstreams.why: You ruled it required for the first classes of the unit (18 Sep). It is the largest item on the plan: the engine has no free vector object yet, so it must start in week 1.
workstreams.nameEn: Free vectors on a blank page, added head to tail

workstreams.done: Points, lines and planes named before they exist are created; guide examples work on an empty canvas.
workstreams.goal: «M אמצע AB» בדף ריק יוצר את A ו-B עם הודעה וביטול בלחיצה, בכל הכלים.
workstreams.name: מתן שם לנקודה, ישר או מישור יוצר אותם
workstreams.schedule: W1–W2: #1566 (load the needed line when a guide example is clicked on an empty canvas). W3–W4: the three classes the 30 Oct sweep found (#2609 placing created points, #2610 four-letter faces, #2611 a point on a circle). 66 of 238 guide examples still fail on a blank 3-D canvas (was 147).
workstreams.why: Ruled 27 Sep, not yet built. It unblocks a second free vector (#1310); on 30 Oct, 66 of 238 guide examples still fail on a blank 3-D canvas (147 of 230 before #1467).
workstreams.nameEn: Naming a point, line or plane creates it

workstreams.done: Points on cube edges with lengths or ratios, letters in coordinates, |AC| = |BD|, both values of k — all build; a crash never loses the figure.
workstreams.goal: תרגילי וקטורים רגילים אף פעם לא נדחים בטעות ולא מסורטטים חלקית.
workstreams.name: תרגילי וקטורים רגילים לא נדחים ולא מסורטטים חלקית
workstreams.schedule: W3–W5. The 3-D bugs placed 30 Oct join in W4–W5.
workstreams.why: Each is a standard textbook input that fails today.
workstreams.nameEn: Standard vector exercises are never refused or half-drawn

workstreams.done: «AE = u + t·v», «EM = a·EA + b·EC» solved, the exam's own question wording, a line's equation on request.
workstreams.goal: שאלות מאוחרות ביחידה עונות ב-t, a ו-b במקום «לא נקבע».
workstreams.name: התשובות שומרות על האותיות t, a ו-b
workstreams.why: Uniqueness of representation is curriculum item 2 of the unit; the exam (572 Q2) asks these.
workstreams.nameEn: Answers keep the letters t, a and b

workstreams.done: The 572 Q2 bagrut questions and your book examples build step by step, easily and correctly. You play the sheet before the first lesson.
workstreams.goal: ה-3-D מוכן מספיק כדי ללמד וקטורים.
workstreams.name: אתה בודק: שיעורי הוקטורים מוכנים
workstreams.why: The gate for the next phase.
workstreams.nameEn: You check: vector lessons are ready

workstreams.done: Every issue here is closed or ruled.
workstreams.goal: היכולות ב-3-D ששיעורי הוקטורים המאוחרים נשענים עליהן.
workstreams.name: יכולות 3-D לשיעורי הוקטורים המאוחרים
workstreams.why: Placed 30 Oct from outside the plan; not needed for the first lessons.
workstreams.nameEn: 3-D features for the later vector lessons

workstreams.done: The three open wrong-answer bugs are fixed.
workstreams.goal: שום שרטוט 2-D לא שגוי כשהוא נראה נכון, בקלט רגיל.
workstreams.name: שום שרטוט 2-D לא נראה נכון כשהוא שגוי
workstreams.schedule: W1–W2. Ruled 26 Oct: #2499 ships now, accepting one slower refusal (D6); #2538 uses one general rule plus a failure-path fix (D7).
workstreams.why: #2499 you hit yourself (play case T30), so it stays P1. #2538 and #2545 were found by sessions: under the approved scheme they are P2 with a wrong-answer mark.
workstreams.nameEn: No 2-D figure looks right while being wrong

workstreams.done: New priority scheme (#2556) and this roadmap written down with an ADR; milestones created; the open queue re-ranked after you review the summary.
workstreams.goal: העדיפויות בתור עוקבות אחרי מפת הדרכים.
workstreams.name: עדיפויות התור עוקבות אחרי מפת הדרכים
workstreams.schedule: Ruled 26 Oct (D5): the scheme is approved, and a 2-D wrong answer found by a session is P2. Next: one PR (labels, docs, ADR, skills), then the re-rank summary for your review before any relabelling.
workstreams.why: Today P1/P2/P3 measure only how bad a defect is, so 2-D and complex items compete with locus and vectors.

calendar.capacityNote: Measured pace since September: ~90 issues closed a week (~20 features, ~30 analytic). About a quarter of each week is kept for what you or a student hit; anything beyond moves to the next week.
calendar.note: Operator, 2026-10-30: "I start elipses on nov-14. that will be about 2 weeks and then parabola. locus of allipses and parabola will be taught as part of the shape. dec. 1 is a good guess for starting vectors"
